newsitem.title: USA: Drew Industries arranges credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Drew Industries arranges credit facility.

text.p: Drew Industries Inc on Monday it said it secured a $60 million syndicated credit facility, including a $21 million term loan and a $39 million revolving line of credit.

The company said it borrowed about $26 million under the facility at the closing, $21 million of which it used to repay a short-term note issued to finance its purchase of 1.6 million common shares from its chairman. It said it used the other $5 million to refinance borrowings under an existing credit line.
Drew, which makes aluminum windows for manufactured homes and recreational vehicles, said the balance of the revolving credit line was available for working capital purposes and acquisitions.
